title: vault-sync configuration
description: Declares files to synchronize with a secrets provider. vault-sync additionally validates normalized paths, duplicates and Go regular expressions.

account.description: Expected provider account (AWS account ID for S3); for R2, the required Cloudflare account ID selecting the REST API account.

environment.description: Provider environment (Infisical only; defaults to dev).

server.description: Provider instance URL (Bitwarden or Infisical). init saves the selected instance.

region.description: AWS region for the S3 bucket. init saves the selected region; existing manifests may use the AWS CLI default. R2 does not need a region; auto is accepted for compatibility.

project.description: Provider container (Bitwarden personal folder, Infisical project or S3/R2 bucket), optionally followed by /folder/subfolder. Use canonical relative paths without empty, dot or parent segments.

path.description: Local file or directory path. Relative paths stay inside the manifest directory; absolute paths are supported. A trailing slash or . declares a directory.

regex.description: Go regular expression matching slash-separated paths relative to a directory. Also declares the path as a directory.

permissions.description: Quoted octal Unix mode, such as "0600" or "640". Owner read is required; special bits are forbidden. Empty uses 0600.
